notes.note: Traced reset through launcher and home registry observations under the maintenance lease. A generated service protected all selected-home bytes, and an inactive incompatible home archived with byte preservation. Two real CLI races exercised admission before and after the reset's archive rename. Traced import ownership, exact-source progress, per-item publication and the completion ledger. Actual CLI faults at the first progress publish, later integration manifest rename, and final receipt rename produced the documented status and exact retry behavior on generated homes.
